content.user_title: Write Better Jest Tests With Reusable Patterns
content.value_statement: Unit tests often become fragile when they duplicate setup or test implementation details. This skill gives reusable Jest patterns for factories, mocks, render helpers, and TDD.
actual_capabilities: Explains a red-green-refactor workflow for test-driven development.
Shows factory functions for component props and reusable mock data.
Demonstrates a custom React Native render helper with providers.
Provides Jest module and GraphQL hook mocking examples.
Shows Testing Library query and user interaction patterns.
Lists practical test structure guidance and common anti-patterns.
limitations: Focuses on Jest and React Native style tests, not every test framework.
Provides patterns and examples, not runnable project scaffolding.
Does not cover end-to-end browser testing or performance testing.
Assumes the user adapts examples to their local component structure.

use_cases.title: Create Consistent Component Tests
use_cases.description: Use render helpers, factories, and Testing Library queries to write maintainable component tests.

use_cases.title: Introduce TDD Workflow
use_cases.description: Guide a team through failing tests, minimal implementation, and focused refactoring.

use_cases.title: Standardize Mocking Practices
use_cases.description: Apply clear Jest module and hook mocks without testing mock internals.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Unit Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one component test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to write a Jest test for this component. Focus on behavior and use a simple render helper.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Test Factory
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for reusable setup data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to create a factory for these props or data. Include sensible defaults and override support.

prompt_templates.title: Mock a Generated Hook
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a GraphQL or module mock.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to mock this generated hook in Jest. Keep the test focused on visible behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a TDD Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a test-first change plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to design a red-green-refactor plan for this change. Include tests for normal, loading, empty, and error states.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a test for a React Native component with theme context.
output: A test plan that starts with visible behavior.
A render helper recommendation for the theme provider.
Focused assertions using Testing Library queries.

output_examples.input: A user has repeated mock user objects across many tests.
output: A reusable factory approach with default values and overrides.
Guidance to keep test data complete and consistent.
Examples of clearer test setup naming.

output_examples.input: A user needs to mock a GraphQL hook response.
output: A Jest mocking approach for the generated hook.
Separate response states for success, loading, and error cases.
A reminder to assert UI behavior instead of mock internals.

best_practices: Start with a failing test that describes user-visible behavior.
Use factories for props and data so tests stay consistent.
Clear mocks between tests and keep each test focused on one behavior.
anti_patterns: Testing implementation details instead of public behavior.
Duplicating incomplete mock objects across test files.
Asserting that mocks were called when visible behavior is what matters.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Jest, React Native Testing Library, and TypeScript-style component tests.

faq.question: Does it generate complete test files?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and examples that an assistant can adapt into complete tests for a project.

faq.question: Can it help with test data setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends factory functions with defaults and overrides for props and data.

faq.question: Does it cover mocking?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Jest module mocks and generated GraphQL hook mock patterns.

faq.question: Does it support TDD?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes the red-green-refactor workflow and encourages writing failing tests first.

faq.question: Is it safe to install?
faq.answer: The skill is documentation-only. The audit found no malicious intent or executable automation in the skill file.
